mapper.select: SELECT T.IMPORT_ID, T.IMPORT_TYPE, T.FILE_NAME, T.FILE_URL, T.IMPORT_TOTAL, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_import_detail A WHERE A.IMPORT_ID =T.IMPORT_ID AND A.HANDLE_RESULT ='S') SUCCESS_TOTAL, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_import_detail A WHERE A.IMPORT_ID =T.IMPORT_ID AND A.HANDLE_RESULT ='F') FAILURE_TOTAL, T.PROCESS_STATE, T.PROCESS_INFO, T.CREATE_BY, T.CREATE_TIME, T.UPDATE_BY, T.UPDATE_TIME, T.DEPT_ID FROM sys_import_record T WHERE T.IMPORT_ID = #{importId}
